narration: You're checking your 401k — $300,000. Feels amazing, right? Here's what nobody told you: the IRS is the silent co-owner of every dollar in that account, and it gets worse.
visual: Dark background. Large animated counter climbs from $0 to $300,000 in white. Below: full white bar, then red section grows from right to cover 22%. Red badge: '22% = $66,000 — BELONGS TO THE IRS' springs in.

narration: Every contribution you made went in before taxes — so the government never got its cut. Every single withdrawal in retirement gets taxed as regular income. Let me show you the math.
visual: Light background. Dollar coin SVG labeled 'YOUR PAYCHECK' with arrow pointing right into a vault/safe icon labeled '401K — PRE-TAX.' Second arrow from vault to a future person silhouette labeled 'TAXED AS INCOME AT WITHDRAWAL.' Timeline: NOW to RETIREMENT.

narration: Run the math on $300,000. At a 22% tax rate, $66,000 of that balance belongs to the IRS — not you. Your real number is $234,000. And here's where it actually gets worse.
visual: Dark background. Tall rectangle bar animates in from bottom, then splits: 78% white section labeled '$234,000 — YOURS' and 22% red section labeled '$66,000 — IRS.' Total '$300,000' label at top. Both sections animate in sequentially.

narration: At 73, the IRS forces mandatory withdrawals called RMDs — whether you need the money or not. Those forced payouts can push you into a higher tax bracket. But there is a fix.
visual: Light background. Horizontal age timeline: 60, 65, 70, 72, then at 73 a red warning triangle appears with 'RMD KICKS IN.' Arrow pointing down to a piggy bank cracking open. Text: 'FORCED WITHDRAWAL' with bracket showing higher tax rate impact.

narration: The Roth IRA flips this completely — you pay tax on the seed, not the harvest. Every dollar of growth comes out tax-free, with no forced withdrawals at 73. Here's the window.
visual: Dark background. Two columns side by side. LEFT 'TRADITIONAL': full dollar coin goes in, smaller coin comes out with red IRS slice removed. RIGHT 'ROTH': slightly smaller coin goes in with tax paid, full large coin comes out in green. Arrows and labels animate in.

narration: Your Roth conversion window is 60 to 72 — before the IRS forces your hand. If your bracket is lower now than it'll be at 73, converting today is how you take your money back.
visual: Light background. Age bar 55-75 with green highlight over 60-72 labeled 'YOUR WINDOW' and red zone at 73+ labeled 'RMDs TAKE OVER.' Large CTA text: 'CONVERT BEFORE 73.' Green checkmark springs in. 'Talk to a tax advisor' at bottom.
